changelog.body:
## 修改
- 系统层隐藏改为通用方案并优化性能
- 拆分了绕过焦点检查选项，现在可以选择绕过程度
- 其他各项优化若干
## 新增
- oplus小窗菜单隐藏（通过hook systemui实现）

## Modifications
- Changed system-level hiding to a universal solution and optimized performance
- Split the option for bypassing focus checks; you can now choose the bypass level
- Various other optimizations
## Additions
- Added OPLUS floating window menu hiding (implemented by hooking SystemUI)

- 添加系统层隐藏功能以隐藏小窗边框和阴影（自行测试是否可用）
- 系统框架允许选择进作用域
-  解决部分应用进程名特殊导致的问题
- 优化了应用hook的性能
- 调整了部分界面，修复了一些小问题
- 移除硬编码中文

- Added system-level hiding feature to hide pop-up window borders and shadows (self-test for availability)
- System framework now allows selecting apps to include in scope
- Fixed issues caused by special process names in some apps (#10)
- Optimized app hook performance
- Adjusted UI and fixed some minor issues
- Removed hardcoded Chinese strings

-  #6 添加英文与繁体中文语言
- 修改webview处理逻辑，现在自动随主进程配置
- 允许截图到壁纸层改为应用配置

- #6 Add English and Traditional Chinese languages  
- Modify webview handling logic, now automatically follows main process configuration  
- Change "allow screenshot to wallpaper layer" to application configuration

# 问题修复
- 窗口变化时隐藏标识丢失
- 多窗口叠加时下层窗口隐藏失效
# 变更
- 更换api到101用于适配单独选项控制
- 新增模块控制界面
- 每个功能现可单独开关
- 新增多个隐藏功能（绕过焦点检查，窗口标题修改，隐藏任务界面）

# 勾选要隐藏界面的应用即可，不要勾选系统重要组件！
仅在安卓16测试，能否使用自测

--- # 🖼️ 透明截图 (Transparent Screenshot) *基于 LSPosed 框架的 Xposed 模块，为应用提供全面的截图、录屏及屏幕投射防护。* [![Android](https://img.shields.io/badge/Android-10%2B-brightgreen)]() [![API](https://img.shields.io/badge/Xposed%20API-101-blue)]() [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow)]() --- ## ✨ 核心功能 ### 🛡️ 应用层功能 | 功能 | 说明 | |------|------| | **启用默认窗口隐藏方案** | 通过 `setSkipScreenshot` 标志阻止系统截图和录屏。 | | **去除阴影遮罩** | 移除窗口的阴影效果。 | | **窗口不接收触摸与焦点** | 设置 `FLAG_NOT_FOCUSABLE \| FLAG_NOT_TOUCHABLE \| FLAG_NOT_TOUCH_MODAL`，窗口无法接收任何触摸和焦点事件 (⚠️ 注意：会导致窗口无法点击)。 | | **绕过焦点检查** | 仅设置 `FLAG_NOT_FOCUSABLE`，保留触摸能力 (⚠️ 注意：会导致输入法不弹出)。 | | **隐藏最近任务界面** | 从最近任务列表中移除应用卡片。 | | **修改窗口标题为** | 将窗口标题伪装为系统录屏组件，支持全局品牌选择或自定义标题。 | | **允许截屏至壁纸层** | 窗口完全透明时显示壁纸而非黑色（仅部分应用生效）。 | ### 🔧 系统层隐藏 **系统层隐藏** 通过注入系统框架，在系统服务层级直接拦截窗口的渲染，可同时隐藏窗口及其所属 Task 的阴影/边框。此功能需要在设置中手动开启，并在主界面点击 **系统框架** 进行配置。 > ⚠️ 开启后可能略有卡顿，请按需使用。 --- ## 📖 使用方法 1. 确保设备已 **Root** 并安装了 **LSPosed** 框架。 2. 安装本模块。 3. 打开 LSPosed 管理器，启用本模块。 4. 进入模块界面，**勾选需要生效的目标应用**（作用域）。 5. 在模块界面中点击目标应用，进入配置页，开启所需功能。 6. **强制停止目标应用**后重新启动，配置即可生效。 ### 🌐 全局标题设置 在模块主界面右上角菜单 → **设置**，可以选择默认的窗口标题品牌。应用配置中选择 **"全局"** 模式时，将自动跟随此设置。 ### 🔌 系统层隐藏设置 1. 进入 **设置** → 开启 **系统层隐藏** 开关。 2. 系统将请求添加 `system` 到模块作用域。 3. 返回主界面，点击 **系统框架** 条目。 4. 在系统层隐藏界面中，选择需要隐藏的应用（支持搜索）。 5. 已开启隐藏的应用会自动排在列表最上方。 6. 右上角菜单可切换显示/隐藏系统应用。 --- ## 🔬 技术说明 ### SkipScreenshot 原理 `SkipScreenshot` 是系统窗口与渲染流程中的标识，用于指示某个窗口或界面在进行截图、录屏或屏幕投射时应被 **跳过**，不参与最终画面的合成。 **当该标识生效时：** - 应用界面在设备本地仍然可见、可交互。 - 系统截图、录屏或投射结果中 **不会包含** 该界面内容。 ### SystemUI 增强 - Oplus 小窗菜单隐藏 在 **设置** 中开启 **SystemUI 菜单隐藏（Oplus 增强）** 后，模块会 Hook SystemUI 进程中的 `FlexibleMenuManager`，在 OPPO/一加设备的自由窗口（小窗）弹出菜单时，自动对该菜单的 Surface 施加 `setSkipScreenshot`，使其不显示在截图/录屏中。 此功能仅适用于 OPPO/一加 ColorOS 15/16 设备。 ### 修改窗口标题原理 当窗口标题为特定字符串时，系统在截屏和录屏中会跳过合成该窗口，从而达到隐藏效果。 ### 系统层隐藏原理 系统层隐藏直接作用于系统服务 (`system_server`) 的窗口管理机制，在目标窗口的 Surface 创建时就为其设置 `setSkipScreenshot` 标志，并将该标志同步应用到窗口所属的 Task 容器，从而同时隐藏窗口内容和阴影边框。 --- ## ⚠️ 注意事项 > **本模块涉及对系统窗口管理机制的深度干预。使用前请确保您了解相关风险，并具备基本的窗口系统知识。因不当配置导致的系统界面异常、功能失效或其他不可预期的问题，由用户自行承担。** --- ## 🔒 权限说明 本模块需要以下权限： - `QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES` – 用于获取已安装应用列表。 - Xposed 框架权限 – 用于 Hook 目标应用窗口。 --- ## 📄 免责声明 本工具仅供 **安全研究** 和 **个人学习** 使用。 请勿用于侵犯他人隐私或版权的用途。 使用本模块产生的任何后果由用户自行承担。 --- ## 🙏 致谢 本模块的核心功能实现受到了以下优秀项目的启发： | 项目 | 说明 | |------|------| | [SpoofTitle](https://github.com/ZhongYeZi-meow/SpoofTitle) | 窗口标题伪装逻辑 | | [-HideScreen-](https://github.com/zjkkzk/-HideScreen) | 防截屏问题修复 | ---

--- # 🖼️ Transparent Screenshot *A LSPosed module that provides comprehensive screenshot, screen recording and screen casting protection for apps.* [![Android](https://img.shields.io/badge/Android-10%2B-brightgreen)]() [![API](https://img.shields.io/badge/Xposed%20API-101-blue)]() [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow)]() --- ## ✨ Core Features ### 🛡️ App-Level Features | Feature | Description | |---------|-------------| | **Enable default window hiding** | Prevents system screenshots and recordings via the `setSkipScreenshot` flag. | | **Remove shadow mask** | Removes window shadow effects. | | **Block touch and focus** | Sets `FLAG_NOT_FOCUSABLE \| FLAG_NOT_TOUCHABLE \| FLAG_NOT_TOUCH_MODAL`; window becomes unclickable (⚠️ Note: window will become unclickable). | | **Bypass focus check** | Sets only `FLAG_NOT_FOCUSABLE`, touch events remain intact (⚠️ Note: keyboard input will not pop up). | | **Hide recent tasks** | Removes app card from recent tasks list. | | **Modify window title to** | Disguises window title as system recorder component; supports global brand selection or custom title. | | **Allow screenshot to wallpaper layer** | Shows wallpaper instead of black when window is fully transparent (some apps only). | ### 🔧 System-Level Hiding **System-level hiding** works by injecting into the system framework to intercept window rendering at the system service level. It can hide both the window and the shadows/borders of its parent Task. This feature must be manually enabled in settings, and configured by tapping **System Framework** on the main screen. > ⚠️ May cause slight lag; use only when needed. --- ## 📖 Usage 1. Make sure your device is **rooted** and has **LSPosed** framework installed. 2. Install this module. 3. Open LSPosed manager, enable the module. 4. Enter the module interface, **select the target apps** (scope). 5. Click a target app to enter its configuration page, enable desired features. 6. **Force stop** the target app, then restart it – the settings will take effect. ### 🌐 Global Title Setting Menu in the top right corner → **Settings**. You can choose the default window title brand. When an app configures its title mode as **"Global"**, it will automatically follow this setting. ### 🔌 System-Level Hiding Setup 1. Enter **Settings** → turn on **System-level hiding**. 2. The system will request adding `system` to the module scope. 3. Return to main screen, tap the **System Framework** entry. 4. In the system hide screen, select the apps you want to hide (search supported). 5. Apps with hiding enabled are automatically sorted to the top. 6. The top-right menu can toggle showing/hiding system apps. --- ## 🔬 Technical Notes ### How SkipScreenshot Works `SkipScreenshot` is a flag in the system window and rendering pipeline that marks a window or surface to be **skipped** during screenshot, screen recording, or casting operations. **When this flag is active:** - The app UI remains visible and interactive on the device. - The system screenshot, recording, or casting result **will not include** that window's content. ### SystemUI Enhancement – Oplus Floating Menu Hiding After enabling **SystemUI menu hiding (Oplus)** in **Settings**, the module hooks into the `FlexibleMenuManager` in the SystemUI process. When the floating window menu appears on OPPO/OnePlus devices, it automatically applies `setSkipScreenshot` to the menu's Surface, hiding it from screenshots/recordings. This feature is only available on OPPO/OnePlus ColorOS 15/16 devices. ### How Window Title Modification Works When the window title matches certain well‑known system recorder components, the system will skip compositing that window during screen capture, effectively hiding it. ### How System-Level Hiding Works System-level hiding directly operates on the window management mechanism of the system service (`system_server`). It sets the `setSkipScreenshot` flag for the target window's Surface at creation time, and applies the same flag to the window's parent Task container, thereby hiding both the window content and its shadow/border. --- ## ⚠️ Cautions > **This module deeply intervenes in the system window management mechanism. Please ensure you understand the risks and possess basic knowledge of window systems before use. Any system UI abnormalities, feature failures, or other unforeseen issues caused by improper configuration are the user's own responsibility.** --- ## 🔒 Permissions This module requires the following permissions: - `QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES` – to retrieve the list of installed apps. - Xposed framework privileges – to hook into target app windows. --- ## 📄 Disclaimer This tool is intended for **security research** and **personal learning** only. Do not use it for infringing upon others’ privacy or copyright. The user assumes all responsibility for any consequences arising from the use of this module. --- ## 🙏 Acknowledgements Core functionality inspired by the following excellent projects: | Project | Description | |---------|-------------| | [SpoofTitle](https://github.com/ZhongYeZi-meow/SpoofTitle) | Window title spoofing logic | | [-HideScreen-](https://github.com/zjkkzk/-HideScreen) | Anti‑screenshot fixes | ---
